full_page.content:
1911
FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 12 Page 5 Cont.
Apr. 16 Easter Sunday Snowstorm during 6% Mass, about one hour
April 24 St. Fidelis, Funeral Mass at 10.30 for Wm Keiley. Rt. Rev. Bishop Kieley of Savannah, Ga. was celebrant. Not having his regular vestment, he read the Mass. Rt. Rev. Bishop Northope of Charleston, S.C. with Rev. Fr. Doni- gan and Rt. Rev. Mons. Barrett of Brooklyn were in the Sanctuary - servers were C. Heffermen, F. Keegan, B. Landy, J. Fitzpatrick an L. Brue.
April 28 Funeral of Mr. T. Hawley aged about 45 Fr. Solanus with F. Keegan, J. Fitzp. and L. Brue went to Cemetary. (Heffernan and B. Landy concented to stay (after serving) at house.
Page 6
May 28 200 children received First Holy Communion
May 21 Laying of Cornerstone of St. Barnabas Church
June 4th Laying of St. Dennis' Church Cornerstone in Lowery
June 1st M. Dcane donated $15.00 for fare West.
June 2nd Mr. Carroll = $ 5.00 =
